newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador inflation falls to 1.5 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador inflation falls to 1.5 pct in August.

text.p: Prices in El Salvador rose by 1.5 percent in August, down from the July rate of 1.6 per cent, the Finance Ministry said Monday.
Accumulated inflation for the first eight months of the year was 8.3 percent, down from 8.8 percent during the same period last year.
Prices over the 12 months to the end of August rose 10.8 percent.
"In general terms, inflation is tending to fall with the appearance of new agricultural harvests on a national and a Central American level," it said.
The Salvadorean government has set a target of holding inflation to less than 10 percent this year.
